description.text: Training objectives This major develops the basic knowledge of electronic technology and information systems, and can engage in advanced engineering and technical personnel for the research, design, manufacture, application and development of all kinds of electronic equipment and information systems.Student mainly studies the acquisition and processing of signal, the information system of power plant equipment and other professional knowledge. It has been trained in the basic practice of electronic and information engineering, and has the ability to design, develop, apply and integrate electronic equipment and information systems.Internship curriculum experiment, computer training, curriculum design, production practice, graduation design, etc. It is generally required that the practice of teaching is not less than 30 weeks.Durationfour yearsDegree Awarded Bachelor of Engineering

duration.text: The Electronic Information Engineering at North China University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4111 USD/per year ￥ 29600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Passport ;2.Application form ;3.High school transcripts ;4.High school graduation certificate;5.Self-introduction video ( 3-5 minutes ):Self-introduction (age, family background, education background, personality, hobbies)Why do you choose to study this major ?Why do you choose to study in Nanchang Hangkong University ?How do you spend your four years in China ?Documents needed for applying for JW202 form:6.two inch photo (photo of passport);7.physical examination form;8.non-criminal record;9.Proof of bank deposit.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health.2. Education background and age limit:Applicants for undergraduate program must have senior high school diploma with good academic performance and be under the age of 22.3.Obey the relevant laws of the PRC and meet the admission requirements of the host universities.4. Applicants must have a good academic record and merits.
